title: Chapter 1410
text:
Han Xiao shook his head and threw this thought out of his mind for the time being.

He did not even have a clue about the location of the World Tree's main body. It was better not to think too much.

He turned around and looked at the [Tyracles Mechanical Legacy] on his Talent Interface. This ability would unlock new exclusive blueprints when he reached level 360. Although he currently had a very rich technical foundation, no Mechanic would complain about having too many Gold blueprints.

Back then, when [Tyracles Mechanical Inheritance] was at level 320, he had unlocked the King and the Emperor's Robe. The former was still playing a huge role.

This time, he had unlocked three gold blueprints at level 360. Han Xiao opened the introduction of the blueprints and took a look.

[Blueprint-Dark Gold Furnace Beast]: After the Saint Tyracles Race saw the might of the Mechanical Deity, they fervently researched a series of special equipment dedicated to the Mechanical Deity.

[Blueprint-Emperor Skysplitter Blade]: After the Saint Tyracles Race saw the might of the Mechanical Deity, they fervently researched a series of special equipment dedicated to the Mechanical Deity.

[Blueprint-Space Constant Debugger (Incomplete)]: The ultimate technology of the Saint Tyracles Race has not been completely perfected.

"This …"

The corners of Han Xiao's mouth twitched.

Of the five gold blueprints brought by [Tyracles Mechanical Inheritance], three were equipment dedicated to the Mechanical Deity. He could see how passionate this race was about the Mechanical Deity.

The Dark Gold Furnace Beast was a special external body. Its introduction was that it could share the power of the Mechanical Deity's descent and had an independent consciousness. It could act as the Mechanical Deity's mount. The Emperor Skysplitter Blade was a high-tech composite giant weapon. It looked like a double-headed broadsword. The blade was straight and wide, and there were many empty slots that could be used to integrate different parts.

Han Xiao summoned the 3D model and simply outlined the appearance of the Mechanical Deity. He then added the Emperor's Robe, the Dark Gold Furnace Beast, and the Emperor Skysplitter Blade. Although the image was majestic, he felt that it was becoming more and more familiar.

"It looks more and more like Guan Yu? It's just that the weapons don't match … No, why does it look like Thanos? "

Han Xiao mumbled softly, not knowing what to say.

This group of Saint Tyracles scientists who were passionate about the Mechanical Deity spent all their time researching and changing equipment. Did they think they were playing with Nuannuan?

Furthermore, the name of the blueprint made these Saint Tyracles scientists seem a little chuunibyou …

Han Xiao had Jayz's treasure and a portion of the Sanctum's technological foundation, so he did not lack the exclusive metal blueprints of the Mechanical Deity. Although these two blueprints were quite powerful, they were not of much help. However, he discovered that the Emperor's Robe, Dark Energy Gold Furnace Beast, and Emperor Skysplitter Blade actually had set effects, which was rare.

When the three pieces of equipment were activated at the same time, it would trigger a special set effect called 'Tyracles's Frenzy', which would increase his total Machinery Affinity by 1.1x, as well as increase his overall attack, defense, and mechanical performance. It was not bad.

What made Han Xiao excited was the last blueprint. The Saint Tyracles race had a deep understanding of space. As the name suggested, this Space Constants Adjuster could adjust the spatial structure of an area and change the universal constants.

The principle of this device involved the miniature expansion and collapse of the universe, as well as the technology of increasing and decreasing dimensions. According to theory, it should have the special effects of extending or shrinking space, overlapping areas, intercepting or grafting space, and so on. Furthermore, the changes to the area were permanent, and there was no time limit. It was a strategic mechanical device.

For example, if the enemy was only three days away from them, this device could expand or shrink the strategic depth of the distance between the two sides. According to the limit of its effect, it could expand the three-day journey to more than ten days or even a few months, or it could shrink the distance into an inch and instantly engage in close combat.

Unfortunately, these were all theoretical guesses. Before the Saint Tyracles race could perfect this device, they had been wiped out by their opponents during the exploration era. If they had perfected this technology, the current three Universal Civilizations might have become the four Universal Civilizations, or even the only civilization. However, there were no ifs in the world.

"Most of the technology left behind by the Saint Tyracles race has been inherited by the Radiant Federation. I wonder if they have this incomplete blueprint …"

Han Xiao stroked his chin and pondered.

The Space Constant Debugger was even more powerful than the World Tree's Lerbo Space Protection Belt. If the Radiant Federation had this technology, they would have used it back then. However, he could not rule out the possibility that they had not perfected it.

After thinking for a while, Han Xiao shook his head and stopped thinking about it.

Regardless of whether the Radiant Federation had it or not, he had it. If not for the talent [Tyracles Mechanical Legacy], he would not have had the chance to get his hands on it.

Beep beep beep …

Just as Han Xiao was researching his new ability, his communicator suddenly rang. He received a message. It was an invitation from the leaders of the three Universal Civilizations.

"Heh, you're finally here."

Han Xiao glanced at it and was not surprised.

He had opened up a new level of individual strength, so the three Universal Civilizations would definitely not be able to sit still. They would talk to him sooner or later, but they did not come looking for him immediately after he advanced. They probably heard from Wuornos that he wanted to familiarize himself with his strength, so they specially waited a day and did not dare to disturb him.

After replying to the message, Han Xiao turned on the remote projection. His vision changed, and he arrived at the joint conference room of the three Universal Civilizations. He saw the three of them sitting side by side.

The three of them sized up Han Xiao carefully. Their faces were expressionless, and no one knew what they were thinking.

"Cough, Black Star, I heard that you broke through the upper limit of the Beyond Grade A and entered a new level of strength. Congratulations on breaking the record."

The corners of Marbruce's mouth twitched, and he forced a smile as he nodded.

Han Xiao did not mind and said humbly, "It's just luck."

"Is, is that so …"

Marbruce was stunned, and his expression stiffened.

It seems like you have the least right to say that …

Han Xiao suddenly smiled at the Ethereal Pope and said, "By the way, I haven't thanked you for your help. It's all thanks to you guys agreeing to lend me the Ethereal National Weapon. Otherwise, I wouldn't have been able to advance."

"…"

The Ethereal Pope's eyes twitched.

Provocation, this is definitely a provocation!

He regretted it the moment he thought of this.

Han Xiao mentioning it in front of him was mocking him for making a losing deal!

The Ethereal Pope looked at Han Xiao's smile and felt extremely disgusted. He wanted to pick up the cup on the table and smash it on this guy's head.

This time, Marbruce and Louis turned to look at him with strange gazes. It was as if they were blaming him for betraying the revolution.

However, the two of them did not see the Ethereal Pope's angry expression as they expected. The Ethereal Pope took a deep breath and suddenly calmed down. He revealed an unfathomable smile and said righteously, "You're welcome.

You've stepped into a higher level, and it's beneficial to the battle. Of course, we won't be stingy. "

Han Xiao raised his brows, and his heart skipped a beat.

It seemed like Wuornos had indeed reported it to the Ethereal higher-ups. He should be eager to learn his method to advance. The Ethereal Pope's performance this time was clearly because he thought that Wuornos would be able to step into the Transcendent God level very soon, so he felt that it was not a loss and was confident.

'Tsk, don't blame me then. You couldn't help it …'

Han Xiao pursed his lips.

To be honest, when he invited Wuornos to help him advance, he really did not intend to trick him. At least, the Ethereal National Weapon and the five elements were real advancement conditions.

However, Han Xiao was not prepared to tell others about the secret of the Beyonder's Vestige for the time being. If Wuornos was determined to advance, he could only sit back and watch.

After all, Wuornos did not seem to be planning to participate in the battle. Whether he lived or died did not matter to him. In any case, even if he died, he could still use the remaining heat in the form of the Beyonder's Vestige. Han Xiao did not mind at all …

However, after satisfying two Promotion conditions, it could at least increase the success rate of the Promotion by two-thirds. As long as Wuornos' luck was not as bad as his, there would be no problem for him to advance … However, without the Beyonder's Vestige, he could only trigger a normal Promotion. When he completed the Promotion excitedly, he realized that his strength had not broken through the restrictions of his Promotion. No one knew what expression he would have.

Han Xiao calmed himself down and asked casually, "You're looking for me just to congratulate me?"

"After all, this is a major event in history. We want to ask if you want to make it public to the galactic society?"

Louis nodded and asked.

"There's no need for that. We're still at war. We're not sure if the World Tree will steal information on the internet in the future. It's enough for the upper echelons to know."

Han Xiao shook his head.

Seeing that the three of them had no objections, he suddenly turned to Marbruce and said,

"Speaking of which, I still need the dynasty's help with something."

"What is it?"

"I plan to send EsGod into the Underworld after a while and use him on the battlefield."

"This …"

Marbruce hesitated.

The dynasty had sealed EsGod for so long mainly because they wanted to study his body after his soul was destroyed. Marbruce did not want to agree to this request, and he did not want to see the Underworld increase in experts.

Seeing his hesitation, Han Xiao's eyes flashed.

"As a deal, I can provide you with a very interesting piece of information."

"What information?"

"Gaud's whereabouts." Han Xiao curled his lips.

Marbruce's pupils constricted.

Although he had vaguely guessed that Black Star was the one behind Gaud's disappearance, he could not help but feel shocked and angry when he heard him admit it personally.

Thinking about how he had been played around by Black Star and caused a huge commotion, Marbruce's face darkened. He suppressed his anger and shouted, "Who is it?"

"… So it's you!"

Han Xiao did not think much of it. He waved his hand and said, "Don't be angry. I have a reason for doing this. If you're willing to agree to this deal, I'll tell you the reason and give you Gaud's whereabouts."

Marbruce clenched his fists and thought quickly.

Black Star had only revealed his cards now, which was undoubtedly related to his recent Promotion. There was only one reason for doing so, and that was that the strength of a Transcendent was beyond imagination. He no longer needed to worry about the revenge of the advanced civilizations, which was why Black Star could reveal this secret as a bargaining chip without any hesitation!

The strength of a Transcendent was still a mystery. They only knew that it was higher than a Beyond Grade A, but other than Black Star, no one knew how strong it was. The unknown was the most terrifying.

With Black Star's current confidence, it was obvious that the strength of a Transcendent was not to be underestimated. In fact, he had chosen to reveal his cards at this time to establish his dominance!

Thinking of this, Marbruce immediately felt a strong sense of fear. The current situation did not allow for internal strife, so he had no choice but to suppress the anger in his heart and think about Black Star's suggestion.

After a while, he nodded expressionlessly and said coldly, "I can give you EsGod.

"I can give you EsGod, but we have to get Gaud back. I only hope that your reason will satisfy us."

"Don't worry, you'll definitely be satisfied."

Han Xiao did not mind.

He had chosen to reveal his cards at this time because he wanted to strike while the iron was hot. If he did not perform well and continued to maintain the original relationship, the three Universal Civilizations might feel that he did not have much confidence. It was time to take a step forward to pressure them and extract more benefits. At the same time, he would let the three Universal Civilizations see his' unbridled 'attitude, which would make them even more fearful and yearn for his strength after his Promotion.

Of course, he had the confidence to do this. Firstly, the three Universal Civilizations could not do without the help of the association. Secondly, with his own strength, he no longer needed to be afraid of the three Universal Civilizations.

Some of the 'crimes' left behind in history could be brought to the surface because the three Universal Civilizations could no longer flip the table.

Furthermore, it was not a good idea to keep Gaud locked up. The matter had to be resolved eventually. He had to tell the dynasty the whole story. In the future, if Evans obtained the Esper Ability to control energy, he would be able to use it openly.

After glancing at the three of them one last time, Han Xiao did not say anything. He deactivated the remote projection and disappeared from the room.

Only then did the three of them relax their tense bodies. They looked at each other with subtle expressions.

They were testing him this time mainly to see if Black Star's attitude had changed after his Promotion.

Back then, when the Beyond Grade As had just appeared, they had also had an impact on the structure of the universe. Although they did not know how big the leap in strength would be this time, it would definitely not be weak. Furthermore, Black Star was already recognized as the leader of the Beyond Grade As. Now that he had broken through, the three of them had no choice but to reconsider how they should treat Black Star.

Before the meeting, the three of them had already come to a consensus. It would be best to deal with all changes by sticking to the status quo. If Black Star's attitude did not change, they would treat Black Star the same way they treated him in the future. They might as well pretend that the Promotion did not happen and not do anything else.

However, Black Star's attitude made their plan fail. Seeing how fearless he was, the three of them felt even more depressed. Fear seeped into their bones. They knew that the scales of cooperation between the two sides were about to tilt toward the association again.

However, with the enemy before them, they could not do without Black Star. The three of them did not dare to do anything anymore. They were completely at their wit's end. They could only feel helpless.

…

Two days later, at the Beyond Grade A Association …

The venue was filled to the brim. All the association members had been summoned to participate in this impromptu regular meeting.

Everyone's eyes were on Han Xiao, who was sitting on the main seat. Their eyes were filled with surprise, excitement, disbelief, and so on.

Over the past few days, a rumor had spread among the upper echelons of the association, claiming that Black Star had already broken through the boundary of the Beyond Grade A realm and opened up a new level.

At first, not many people believed it, but there was no smoke without fire. As more and more association members found out about it, many of them became skeptical.

Han Xiao scanned everyone's faces, smiled, and said, "Today, I'm here today to announce an announcement.

"Today, I've gathered all of you here to announce something. From the looks of it, I'm sure you've heard about it."

Hearing this, many people's eyes narrowed.

"Black Star, is that rumor true?" Manison frowned, somewhat in disbelief.

Han Xiao looked at him, then at everyone's eager faces. He nodded and said with a firm tone, "That's right.

I've already stepped into the domain above the Beyond Grade A realm. I'll name it the Transcendent Grade. From now on, the Beyond Grade A realm is no longer the limit of individual strength … Everyone, there's still a path ahead! "

As soon as he said that, everyone was shocked!

Everyone stared at Han Xiao in shock. For a moment, they were speechless. The room suddenly fell into a strange silence.
